resources.string: A transparent camera wallpaper that watches for nearby vehicles and obstacles, with on-device hazard alerts.
A transparent live wallpaper with on-device hazard awareness. Frames never leave your phone.
Camera permission required before detection can run
Live wallpaper is not active yet
No live wallpaper picker is available on this device.
Tap \"Set live wallpaper\", choose Android Clear in the system picker, then return to the home screen. Camera capture stops automatically whenever the wallpaper is hidden.
Suppresses the red visual flash. Uses spoken labels, a low-latency tone, and a vibration pattern instead.
System screen-reader mode detected: Blind Assist is active automatically.
Play a short tone when a nearby object is detected.
Use a haptic pattern for hazard alerts.
Controls how strongly the camera preview shows through your home screen.
When armed, a confirmed hazard saves a JPEG burst to Pictures/Android Clear/Threat Captures. Three quick taps on the home screen arm it for a few seconds.
Slower cadences use less battery. Detection always stays on.
Detection runs locally with a bundled EfficientDet-Lite0 model. No images or detections are uploaded.
Safety notice: this is an assistive prototype, not a certified mobility or driving aid. Never rely on it to avoid traffic or other hazards.
Blind Assist always uses sound and vibration.
